core.description: A foundational UI sound pack with essential clicks, toggles, pops, notifications, and transitions, designed to feel clear and familiar across everyday product interactions without overwhelming the interface.

crisp.description: A bright FM-forward collection with precise, snappy transients and a clean top-end, ideal for modern interfaces that need fast, articulate feedback with plenty of clarity.

minimal.description: An ultra-clean sine-based palette for quiet, transparent UI feedback, made for products that prioritize subtlety, restraint, and smooth interaction cues over expressive flourish.

organic.description: A resonant FM collection with bell-like tones, natural reverb tails, and acoustic warmth, crafted to make digital interactions feel softer, more human, and less synthetic.

playful.description: A lively pack of bouncy pitch sweeps and energetic tones with a playful, cartoon-like character, perfect for gamified flows, rewards, and moments that should feel fun and upbeat.

soft.description: A warm triangle-wave pack with gentle envelopes and rounded timbre, intended for calm, friendly products that need reassuring feedback without sharp attacks or harsh brightness.

seed-a-soft.description: Seed pack A, soft theme: gentle sine and triangle taps, toggles and notices.

swoosh._note: APPROXIMATION: source sweeps filter freq one-way (high->low) exponentially; our filter.envelope models rise-then-fall, so we set baseline=low end, peak=high start, attack~instant, decay=full duration to mimic the downward sweep.

layers._note: gain has no linear attack ramp in source (jumps straight to peak then exponential decay); modeled as envelope.attack=0.
gain has no linear attack ramp (jumps straight to 0.24 then exponential decay); modeled as envelope.attack=0. No filter applied to this noise transient in source.

seed-d.description: Seed pack D: nine hand-tuned presets, tap, pop, notify and friends.

seed-e.description: Seed pack E: tone and noise primitives with attack, decay and filter shaping.

seed-f.description: Seed pack F: nine tonal profiles crossed with hover, click and confirm roles.

found.description: One-off recreations of sounds found in the wild. slider-tick: from a viral X/twitter perfect-slider prompt screenshot (520Hz sine -> 1500Hz lowpass, 5ms attack, 45ms decay); parameters were publicly posted, recreated by hand.

recent.description: Core-family variants: layered presses with noise ticks and FM, two-note toggles, open/close sweeps, select, pop, and a featherweight hover. Mostly one-knob adjustments of core pack characters.

seed-g.description: Seed pack G: hover-text melody notes on a pentatonic ratio set, plus one theme-toggle sweep.
